## Remake plan

**5 AI shots → 1 generation unit, 1 Seedance 2.5 call; 5 code-rendered / screen-recording shots → 1 code project (5 segments)**

- The default engine, Seedance 2.0 (including Mini / Fast), cannot produce several shots in one call; with it you would generate the 5 shots one by one. This plan assumes Seedance 2.5 (≤30 s per call, multi-shot in one call): 1 call in total
- Grouping rules: AI shots in the same set joined by hard cuts are merged into one generation (S01); ≤30 s per call; consecutive hard cuts inside a unit should stay ≤8 s, at most 10 s (S06); split at dissolves / fades and set changes (S03)
- Audio: the model can generate action sound effects and ambience along with the picture; voice-over is better done as separate TTS and mixed in, so you can change the script and timing

- Summary: a two-person scripted dialogue between a home creator and a professional mentor shows an open-source Xiaohongshu account-diagnosis tool diagnosing a post's cover images and title and suggesting fixes.
- Form: narrative; hook: opens straight on the pain point with a screenshot and a provocative claim: a post published 21 minutes ago is judged 90% likely to flop, which grabs creators' attention instantly.
- Narration: human, two female voices (character A young, short hair, bright and puzzled; character B in a cap, composed mentor); music: low-key, gentle, melody-free bed; captions: white sans-serif with black outline, centered low; a persistent bold title at the top reads "笔记没人看，先别删" ("Nobody's reading your post? Don't delete it yet")
- Overall judgment (VLM): live footage combined with screen recording / screenshots. Two characters (or one actor playing both) shot on a dressed set with careful lighting and wardrobe, intercut with a Markdown diagnostic report and the GitHub repo page to pitch the product.   - 15.7–19.3 s · call to action · "Fine. Next time a post gets no views, don't delete it, run it through this first."

## Notes

- Deterministic forensics are reliable for "is it moving, is it a whole-image push, is the texture rendered, was there a 24→30 frame-rate conversion"; telling live footage, AI and 3D apart relies on the VLM and human review.
